verifications.claim: As of March 17, 2026, power outages in Northern Virginia/DC are concentrated in Fairfax County (~1,150+ customers) and Stafford County (~5,600+ customers).
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Fairfax County...56 homes and businesses are without power...0.01%; Stafford 1 99.983%5927 (R2/R4); Fairfax 56 (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources report far fewer outages (Fairfax: 56 or 2; Stafford: 1) contradicting high claimed numbers; no evidence of concentration there (e.g., Portsmouth 156 higher); date mismatch (sources 03/26/2026).

verifications.claim: As of March 17, 2026, power outages in Northern Virginia/DC include smaller outages in Spotsylvania and Fredericksburg.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm outages in Spotsylvania (62 customers); Fredericksburg not mentioned; 'smaller' relative and imprecise; date mismatch.

verifications.claim: Fairfax County has ~1,153 customers out of power.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: 56 Customers Out (R1); Fairfax 2 99.993%27553 (R2/R4); Fairfax...56 Customers Out (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently report 56 or 2 customers out, directly contradicting ~1,153.

verifications.claim: The ~1,153 customers out of power in Fairfax County are primarily served by Dominion Energy.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Dominion Energy...54 Customers Out...Northern Virginia Electric Coop...2 Customers Out; total 56
verifications.reasoning: Dominion has most outages (54/56), but total is 56 not ~1,153; incorrect attribution of number to Fairfax/Dominion.

verifications.claim: Stafford County has ~5,643 customers out of power.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.reasoning: Sources report only 1 customer out, directly contradicting ~5,643.

verifications.claim: Dominion Energy and NOVEC are addressing repairs.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No explicit mention of Dominion Energy or NOVEC crews addressing or repairing outages; storm/outage pages imply monitoring but not repairs.

verifications.claim: Power outages in Spotsylvania/Fredericksburg are often managed by Rappahannock Electric Coop.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: Rappahannock Electric Coop...Spotsylvania, Virginia currently has the most outages, at 62 customers without power
verifications.reasoning: Sources show Rappahannock tracks/manages outages in Spotsylvania (highest at 62); 'often' interpretive; Fredericksburg not listed.
